notes: Proficiency bonus is +2 at all levels 1-3.
On level up each character adds one Hit Die and rolls that die + the listed hpPerLevelBonus (or takes the fixed average: d6=4, d8=5, d10=6).
Spell slot counts under spellcasting.slotsByLevel are keyed by character level, then by spell level.
Resources with recharge 'short' reset on a short or long rest; 'long' only on a long rest.
